content:
sarah: quick RFC follow-up 1 pick a canonical paging shape for SDKs (py/ts/go) thats transport-agnostic. tradeoffs?

juan: Two axes: transport (HTTP continuation token vs streaming like grpc/ws) and surface (generator/iterator vs pager object).

mike: prefer HTTP tokens as default. simplest for LB and broad compatibility. streaming opt-in.

eve: streaming better for low tail-latency feeds. recommend supporting both but keep same callsite.

juan: resume/retry rules matter. tokens must support resuming mid-page. streaming needs compact resume metadata (seq/token) + server retention window.

mike: SDK should not leak transport. listX() should return iterable/async iterable in all languages; underlying transport chosen by runtime.

sarah: rough APIs: python for page in client.list_objects(...): 
 ts: for await (const page of client.listObjects(...)) 
 go: it := client.ListObjects(ctx, params); for it.Next() { item := it.Item() }

eve: page contract: {items:[], next_token?:string}. SDK maps streaming state to next_token when needed.

mike: retry proposal: HTTP = page retry + dedupe by server item_id. streaming = reconnect with last-seen seq/token; server resumes if within window; else ResumeWindowExceeded fallback.

juan: security: continuation tokens must be opaque and HMAC-signed so servers stay stateless and tokens can be validated.

mike: ops: server publishes resume window (e.g., 5m/1000 items). SDK surfaces clear ResumeWindowExceeded.

eve: telemetry: record transport (http/stream), resume success rate, deduped items, partial page emits.

sarah: decision draft: default HTTP tokens; support streaming opt-in; SDK auto-selects; provide idiomatic iterables; retry semantics as above.

juan/mike/eve: follow-ups: Juan = SDK shim + examples (Wed); Mike = token format + limits (Fri); Eve = resume-window + metrics doc (Tue).

sarah: ping @juan @mike @eve if no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll fold into RFC. :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: created RFC/2026-sdk-paging-transport.md (https://r.rw/rfc/2026)

mike: small nit: SDK dedupe by canonical item_id and expose optional callback for app-level merging.

eve: +1; also add allow_partial_pages flag for earlier visibility on large pages.

sarah: noted, closing unless new issues. :v:
